datasets.label: Equine cartilage
datasets.description: Measured NIR absorbance from equine articular cartilage, used to predict non-calcified cartilage thickness.
datasets.provenance: CC BY 4.0 · Sarin et al., Scientific Data 6, 164 (2019), doi:10.1038/s41597-019-0170-y. Browser snapshot: 120 of 869 measurement locations; replicate acquisitions averaged within location; deterministic 90/30 split; 700–1050 nm retained at every fourth measured wavelength.

datasets.label: Leaf-litter nitrogen
datasets.description: Measured intact and ground leaf-litter reflectance from Cedar Creek and Minneapolis, used to predict nitrogen on a dry-mass basis.
datasets.provenance: CC BY 4.0 · Kothari, Hobbie and Cavender-Bares (2024), doi:10.5061/dryad.hdr7sqvrk. Browser snapshot: deterministic 120-observation subset and target-balanced 90/30 split; 1000–2400 nm retained at every eighth measured wavelength.

datasets.label: Leaf drydown
datasets.description: Measured reflectance during tabletop leaf drydowns, used to predict leaf water potential across species and drying stages.
datasets.provenance: PDDL 1.0 · Allen, Anderegg, Roberts and Trugman (2025), EcoSIS doi:10.21232/egGyynzX. Browser snapshot: three real drying stages per leaf; 36 leaves for calibration and 12 disjoint leaves for validation; 1000–2400 nm retained at every eighth measured wavelength.
